title: v1MarketplaceRegisterEntity
description: Registration request submitted when a marketplace user is redirected to Palette after purchasing a SaaS contract (e.g., from AWS Marketplace). Contains the temporary registration token from the redirect and the user's profile information for tenant and user creation.

firstName.description: User's first name for the admin user profile

lastName.description: User's last name for the admin user profile

orgName.description: Organization name used as the tenant name. Must be unique across the platform.

providerType.description: Marketplace provider type. Defaults to "aws" if empty or omitted.

registrationToken.description: Temporary token provided by the marketplace provider during the redirect after purchase. Must be resolved promptly as it is short-lived (e.g., x-amzn-marketplace-token for AWS).
